summary: Open shopping-strip car park, no homes within about 45 m.
reasons: Sealed car park with marked bays

best_section.where: South-east bays of the car park, beside the access lane and retail units

drivers.seclusion: Surrounded by shops and offices; nearest mapped house is 49 m away and apartments sit behind a planted screen to the south-west.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed lot with open access from the internal lane and no gate; marked bays have room for a van, though it is well used by day.
drivers.traffic: A busy main road runs along the north-west side, and the lot is full of shoppers by day.
drivers.convention: No signs and no campervans seen; many cars parked, so a van would blend in, though overnight use is unconfirmed.

flags: Customer-style car park: overnight rules unknown
Outline slope figures are inflated by the bank edge; the lot is level
Noise from the main road to the north-west
sun_shade: Open to sun; palms and planting shade the north-east and south-west edges.
cannot_judge: Whether the lot is chained at night
